# Chocolate Tail

Chocolate Tail is an obscure G4 unicorn stallion glimpsed in Rarity's imagined Grand Galloping Gala, rather than a character with a developed storyline.

- Appearance: brown coat, golden-brown mane and tail, pale golden-yellow eyes, and a golden laurel-wreath cutie mark. [Unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies).
- Name: a fandom identification name, not verified as an official Hasbro name. The [cutie-mark index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks) places it in quotation marks; the original namer is unknown.
- Speaking status: no verified dialogue or voice actor. No other episode, film, or comic appearance was established.

## Important moments

- **Rarity's dream of high society — The Ticket Master (S1E3).** He is pictured alongside Purple Wave looking toward Rarity in her imagined gala, helping establish the glamorous social world she hopes to enter. [Episode source](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-ticket-master/umc.cmc.2rg4xf8e1msco84hryprlwh92) (timestamp unavailable).

This is the only documented scene I found; additional defining moments would be speculative.

## Images

The [episode image index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Category%3AThe_Ticket_Master_images) lists both a character identification still and the shot with Purple Wave, credited to the 2010 Hasbro Studios production. I could not verify a working direct image URL or an attributed fan artwork, so no image is embedded. Fandom blocked direct page retrieval, and a separate fan site's image returned 404.
